summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OPS_DECK (Spec 02) and ART_V2 (Spec 01) features. All existing test suites passed (41/41 tests). Backend save API regression tests passed (6/6). OPS_DECK acceptance suite passed (26/26). ART_V2 acceptance suite passed (9/9). Additional manual tests verified drawer interactions, purchase flow, photo mode, and legacy fallback modes. Both feature flags (OPS_DECK and ART_V2) toggle correctly via URL parameters and localStorage. No console errors or backend/frontend log errors detected in any mode.
